title: The Clockmaker's Book Cipher
description:
A notebook page listed numerical references: '1-1-1 2-1-2'.
Found beside the book with pages:
Line 1: BEWARE ALL TRAITORS
Line 2: THE COUSIN FLEES
Line 3: IN NIGHT FALL
question: Translate the code 1-1-1 (Line 1, Word 1) 2-1-2 (Line 2, Word 2) to identify the target:
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded phrase.

Example:
THE KEY
hints: Book ciphers use pairs or triplets: Line Number - Word Number.
solution_explanation: Lookup 1-1-1 gives 'BEWARE' from Line 1, and 2-1-2 gives 'COUSIN' from Line 2. Combined phrase: BEWARE COUSIN.
